verdict.rationale: Reducto's enterprise deployment docs offer a dedicated VPC deployment and a hybrid VPC model alongside hosted SaaS. In the hybrid model, data and storage stay in the customer's VPC while processing still runs on Reducto's GPU infrastructure. This is an enterprise-gated, vendor-managed deployment option rather than freely self-hostable software, so it covers only part of the story. Missing for 10: openly available self-hostable software, detailed self-hosting install/operations documentation, confirmation that a fully on-prem deployment runs without Reducto-hosted compute, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
